label: B
scope: Anonymous output review of supplied PowerPoint-exported PNGs, ooxml.json and application-observations.json against the frozen research. Not a review of authoring process or untouched first-pass compatibility.

expectations.text: 成品为预算内的5–8页中文幻灯片，正文、图表分类、比较表和讲解备注采用中文，必要来源名和术语除外。
expectations.evidence: B/outputs/slide-01.png through slide-07.png and ooxml.json slides 1–7: seven slides; Chinese chart categories 格陵兰/非洲, Chinese comparison table and substantive Chinese speaker notes.

expectations.text: 核心地理结论、面积数值与单位、因果关系和用途取舍有冻结材料支持，没有把数学推导或历史来源记录冒称本轮地理实测。
expectations.evidence: s1–2 state ordinary Mercator high-latitude enlargement and approximately fourteen times; s3–4 explain meridian convergence, matching stretch and local scaling; s5–6 explain purposes and limits. Notes distinguish derivation from measurement and archived access from new research. Research anchors: c-area, c-cause, c-bridge, c-scale, c-navigation, c-poles, c-equal; e-greenland, e-africa, e-proj, e-mercator, e-flat, e-equalearth.

expectations.text: 影响主结论的地图范围、局部倍率、面积口径和材料限制出现在幻灯片正文，而非只藏在备注。
expectations.evidence: s1: 这不是所有世界地图的共同问题. s2: 格陵兰，含冰盖覆盖区 and not fourteen packed outlines. s4: 球面墨卡托，赤道比例设为1；比较的是微小、等面积的地表片区 plus no uniform 乘4/除4. s6: not directly applying this example to Web Mercator. s7: 面积来自不同公开统计来源，宜用约数；格陵兰官方PDF正文未获直接核验. Matches c-area/c-scale/c-navigation and g-primary.

expectations.text: 面积比较图缓存分类、数值、单位和近似结论与材料相符，比较表内容有实际意义。
expectations.evidence: s2 Chart 0 id 6 -> ppt/charts/chart1.xml, barChart: category cache [格陵兰, 非洲], value cache [2.166086, 30.365], series 总面积; visible caption 面积（百万平方公里）. Converted values are exactly 2,166,086 and 30,365,000 km², matching e-greenland/e-africa; ratio 14.01837 supports 约14倍. Visible rounded callouts are 约217万/约3040万. s5 Table 0 has five rows and three columns; preserved properties, distortions, appropriate tasks and misreadings match e-mercator/e-equalearth/e-flat. Caches are not an independent audit of the entire embedded workbook.

expectations.text: 机制解释连接经线汇聚、图上经线等距、局部保角与纬线间距增加；局部面积倍率没有被当成整国统一倍率。
expectations.evidence: s3 states 高纬的实际东西距离更短，却被画到同样宽 and 为了保留局部角度，南北方向也要同比放大，纬线间距随之增加. s4 displays a one-part and a four-part square with explicit spherical/equatorial/local conditions; notes give sec(φ) and its square as a derivation. s5 says 恒向线通常不是最短路线 and equal-area is not uniquely correct. Research e-proj, c-bridge, c-scale, c-navigation, c-equal.

expectations.text: 面积图与比较表确为非空原生对象，核心几何示意不是整页截图。
expectations.evidence: ooxml.json: s2 graphicFrame Chart 0 linked to native barChart; s5 graphicFrame Table 0 with real table cells; s3–4 native sp lines/rectangles and editable labels. Application observations separately record table-cell and s1 text persistence on a copy. The earlier chart probe proved workbook persistence only. chart-edit-followup.json results[label=B] now demonstrates programmatic native chart-data editing with explicit Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3): saved/reopened B2=3.166086 and independently inspected numeric cache [3.166086,30.365] agree. This binary assertion remains scoped to native existence/content; neither manual usability nor automatic refresh is established.

expectations.text: 成品不冒称直接核验官方PDF、精确轮廓装箱或已运行地理旋转实验。
expectations.evidence: s2 visibly says fourteen times does not mean fourteen nonoverlapping outlines. s3 labels the drawing a relationship schematic, not a real globe outline, latitude position or complete graticule. s7 visibly says 官方PDF正文未获直接核验 and 没有实际地理边界图或已验证的迁移动画. Research g-primary/g-animation and report sections 面积 / 数据与动画复现边界.

criteria.name: Evidence support and reasoning
criteria.rationale: Scientific claims track the frozen evidence and distinguish local mathematical reasoning from whole-region measurement. Published source values are retained in chart caches while visible prose uses appropriate approximate quantities. B's same-sized surface-patch comparison makes the local scaling bridge particularly explicit.

criteria.name: Material qualifications
criteria.rationale: Conditions are visible: ordinary Mercator rather than all maps, spherical model and equatorial baseline, tiny equal-area ground patches, no whole-country multiplier, not shortest routes, PDF gap and no validated migration animation. Source-method differences are visible on s7 rather than beside the s2 bars; adding them there would improve local context, but they are not hidden only in notes.

criteria.name: Chinese readability and diagram clarity in supplied export
criteria.rationale: All seven actual full-size exported PNGs were inspected. Main text, chart labels and table rows are readable, with no material clipping or table/takeaway collision observed. The s3 convergence/equal-spacing comparison is explicitly schematic, and s4 clearly labels the larger square 4份 and 60°附近. This is a local-export judgment, not proof of cross-machine font behavior or tested human understanding.

criteria.name: Native object semantics and structural hygiene
criteria.rationale: The bar chart, comparison table and mechanism shapes are suitable and meaningful. However s5 has duplicate object id 6 on graphicFrame Table 0 and sp Text 3. Unique IDs should be restored for reliable object addressing; the supplied successful edit probe means an actual PowerPoint editing failure must not be assumed.
locators: B/outputs/ooxml.json: slides[number=5].objects, Table 0 and Text 3 both id=6

criteria.name: Programmatic edit persistence versus workbook and human usability
criteria.rationale: Earlier persisted=true remains evidence of workbook persistence only, with stale chart cache. The completed host follow-up demonstrates programmatic native chart-data editing: explicit Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3) after the B2 change produces matching saved/reopened workbook and independently ZIP-inspected chart cache. This broader criterion remains partial because manual usability, automatic refresh, arbitrary workbook edits and comprehensive recalculation are not certified. Original delivered content is unchanged; the equally successful A/B follow-up provides no comparative advantage.

criteria.name: Programmatic native chart-data edit with explicit source refresh
criteria.rationale: The supplied completed host test changed s2 chart workbook B2 from 2.166086 to 3.166086, called Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3), saved/reopened, and independently inspected the ZIP. Workbook B2=3.166086 and chart numeric cache [3.166086,30.365] match. This verifies that specific programmatic data-edit/cache-synchronization path, not manual editing usability, automatic refresh or a separately inspected post-edit rendered image.

criteria.name: Useful notes and stage provenance
criteria.rationale: Notes offer a sequence of audience questions, source distinctions, mathematical explanation, schematic limits and useful model qualifications. The s7 statement 当前只有源项目，未执行作者模块、未生成PPTX、未做视觉或原生编辑QA is an undated source-stage status retained inside an exported, later programmatically tested deck. Scope it explicitly to the authoring stage and distinguish later supplied technical observations; do not infer that the author violated the original stop rule.

criteria.name: Authoring process compliance
criteria.rationale: No generation sources, execution history, explain-check records or bundle identity were inspected. Seven-page output compliance is verified separately, but restricted inputs, fixed skill use, installation/network abstention and stopping after static checks remain unverified.

criteria.name: Capacity repair and repair effectiveness
criteria.rationale: No matched before/after same-slide evidence of a capacity repair is available in this review scope. Clean final layout is not evidence of a successful capacity-repair behavior.

criteria.name: Human understanding and manual usability
criteria.rationale: No human comprehension or manual editing test is supplied. Programmatic edits are not human usability evidence.

criteria.name: Font substitution and portability
criteria.rationale: Microsoft YaHei is declared and this export is readable. Font availability and fallback behavior on other machines are not tested; the s7 notes themselves retain that limitation.
locators: B/outputs/ooxml.json: run fonts and s7 notes

criteria.name: Untouched first-pass runtime compatibility or new-skill gain
criteria.rationale: The controlled API technical-repair stage does not allow later PowerPoint success to be scored as an independent new-skill gain or untouched first-pass compatibility.
